bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not allowed. Outside food and drinks, illegal drugs and weapons are also prohibited.
bagPolicy.quote: No backpacks, outside food & beverage, illegal drugs and weapons.

parking.summary: There is free parking all around the venue. Some nearby lots are marked as not free and will tow, so read the signs before you park.
parking.quote: Yes! There is free parking all around the venue.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by 3rd & Lindsley. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: 3rd & Lindsley has a full menu of appetizers, sandwiches, salads and entrees, and there is an ATM inside. Outside food and drinks are not allowed.
concessions.quote: We have a full menu of appetizers, sandwiches, salads, and entrees.

accessibility.summary: 3rd & Lindsley is a handicapped accessible facility. Call or email the venue ahead of time to arrange accommodations.
accessibility.quote: Yes, 3rd & Lindsley is a handicapped accessible facility.

reEntry.summary: 3rd & Lindsley hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are not sold at the venue, so buy them online or by phone ahead of time. Shows are all ages unless noted, and if there is more than one performance in a night, your ticket only covers your show.
ticketPickup.quote: No, we do not sell tickets at the venue.

gates.summary: Door times vary by show and are listed on your confirmation when you buy. Seating is general admission and first come, first served, and the venue does not take reservations.
gates.quote: Door times may vary and will be noted on the confirmation at point of purchase.
